sp_widget.client_script: api.controller = function() { var c = this; c.newSection = ""; c.addSection = function() { if (!c.newSection) return; c.server.get({ action: "add_section", section_name: c.newSection, section_order: (c.data.sections.length + 1) * 10 }).then(function(r) { c.data.sections = r.data.sections; c.newSection = ""; }); }; };
sp_widget.name: IBAR Section Builder
sp_widget.template:
